prose: Jorge Mesa of Third Eye Edify returns to talk about Western Musical Theory: the good, the bad, and the muddy. We discuss 432hz, the musical zodiac, audio alchemy, octaves, scales, triads, chords, and the mythos of the origins of music theory. And there is way more than that, in this extra-long episode! Best of all, Jorge plays the bass in this one!
ext: Some topics include the pitch, the overtone series and fractals! We riff on modern music and the cultures around genres, frequency warfare, solfeggio, the language of notation, teaching, and musical archetypes.
